note: The function button (the Anbernic button on the RG Cube) and the Back button of each handheld GammaOS supports. PhoneWindowManager (ThimsyDeviceKeys.java), Nano and drastic-nano (NanoDeviceKeys.cpp) pick the first entry whose match fits the device's properties, else the default. HOTKEYS.md, Devices, explains the fields. linux is the evdev code Nano and drastic-nano read; android is the keycode PhoneWindowManager sees after the key layout.
